verdict.rationale: LM Studio does offer a headless 'llmster' runtime and CLI (lms) marketed for servers/CI without the GUI, suggesting a lighter-weight startup path, but hands-on community feedback contradicts a fast, lightweight cold start: one user notes you still need 'the whole big chonky Electron UI running' even to use the CLI/daemon mode, and another reports LM Studio ran the same model 'MUCH slower' than a comparable lightweight runtime (Ollama) on the same hardware. There is no benchmark or vendor claim quantifying cold-start time or binary size to substantiate the 'fast cold start' claim. Missing for 10: vendor benchmarks on startup latency/binary size, independent confirmation that llmster avoids Electron overhead, and resolution of the reported slower inference performance.
